# Drifting gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-drifting` `LIVE`

## What it does

Drifts from its own frontmatter in all four ways the check reports. No section names `it-rattles`, so the field
carries an id the document answers nowhere. The second section names `it-purrs`, which the field does not carry. That
line stands in the middle of its section rather than closing it, so what a reader takes for a footnote is not one. And
the third section closes on a line naming nothing at all, which claims a coverage it does not state.

### The humming part

Sets the pitch, and holds it.

_**Covers:** [giz-behaving].it-hums_

### The purring part

_**Covers:** [giz-behaving].it-purrs_

Sends it to sleep, which is a behaviour nothing asked this gizmo to answer.

### The idle part

Waits, which is what a gizmo does when nothing is asked of it.

_**Covers:**_

[giz-behaving]: behaving.md
